title.narrative: Renewal of the SILVER Label certification

comment.narrative: Assessment done in December 2024 and certificate raised in January 2025.

This output is designed to be performed in the upcoming year 2024. In fact, the silver labelcertificate is valid until October 2024. At the operational level, the team is working on theindicators related to the gold label requirements and documenting all the supporting documents.However, the main challenge related to the gold label requirements relates to the financialsustainability of the cluster since gold label certificates requires an at least 3 years visibility onthe financial stability of the cluster. For this, the management team is preparing financialforecasts showcasing the minimal budgets required for the viability of the cluster during theupcoming 3 years. In view of this challenge, we will validate whether to apply for the renewal ofthe silver label or for the gold label.
